ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback! We are sorry to hear about the trouble you are having with your new grill. The drippings are caused by the vapors produced from grilling food collecting on the interior surfaces of the new lid. This is the same process that leads to carbonized grease ( https://www.weber.com/US/en/blog/tips-techniques/it-aint-paint/weber-31072.html ) developing on the underside of the cover, but on a brand new grill, the interior surfaces are so smooth that the vapors coalesce into liquid and can run down. If this does not subside, please contact us at reviews@weberstephen.com, and we will be happy to find a solution for you! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Nice barbecue, but I do not believe it is the same quality as my old one of 10+ years (Wish they made stand for the old ones or perhaps ones the do not rust away). I like having two sided stands to use however  the wheels should be on the other side as it is difficult to role with the side stand collapsed (that the side you pick up to role the barbecue). With a full or half filled propane bottle it is almost impossible to keep the temperature below 450. Need a better regulator. Perhaps one not made in China.
Results.Title: Like it!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for taking the time to submit this feedback! We are sorry to hear your crossover has failed under a year. We certainly do not expect this from our Spirit II E-310! We suggest cleaning the crossover tube with a stainless steel brush in an up-down motion to help remove any build-up grease on it. The build-up of grease can cause a blockage and won't allow for the gas to transfer from one burner to another. However, if you still require assistance with his, please do not hesitate to reach us at reviews@weberstephen.com. Thanks!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I was always one of the guys that bought $200 grills and didn’t see why spending the extra on a Weber grill was worth. I was wrong. After replacing several cheap grills, I finally gave this one a try. It cooks so well and is so easy to clean. Love the disposable drip pans under the funneling base of the grill. Way less flare ups and no sludge to clean out of a pan. If you can spare the extra cash, get a Weber. And try that grill spray they have. You can spray it while the grill is hot without worrying about blowing yourself up. And it adds a nice smoky flavor to the food.
Results.Title: Believe the hype

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: My wife and I assembled this unit in one hour.  Rather than use the paper instructions we used the recommended app link - and it was awesome.  We didn’t fight once!  Not even a curse word...  I’ve been using it for a month now, and I am impressed with its consistency.  I have cooked low and slow, and hot and fast.  So far I am a happy customer.
Results.Title: Great assembly app

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We absolutely love our Spirit II E-310 gas grill. So easy to start and with the grilling mats we bought, clean up is so quick and easy. We are grilling more than we ever did before.
Results.Title: Love our Grill

If you want the best , you have to buy the best!
The warranty is worth the price of the grill!
Results.Title: Weber grills are the Best!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This was super easy (and fun with the app!) to put together. We are 4/5 a night grillers and this works well. Easy to fire up, holds the heat well, simple to clean. The biggest selling point for us was the warranty. In Florida weather, no matter how well you protect it, nothing lasts long. Weber grills have. We hope this lives up to the brand. Very happy so far. The only caveat is using wood chips is a challenge due to the even heat. I find that I have to lift up the grate to put the package closer to the fire. Great for food and keeping flare ups down, tough for smoke.
Results.Title: We love it. Easy. Hope it lasts.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
At 73 I still enjoy grilling. Not my first gas grill, but first Weber. First it is well built, easier to clean, change tanks and the grease tray you can access from the front. I particularly I like the mechanical scale to measure the amount of propane in the tank. I roll my grill a lot and wish it had pneumatic tires, even if it had to be an option. The warranty is also attractive. Very satisfied with my purchase. 
PS
I also have the spit attachment.
Results.Title: Still Grilling

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)

Results.Title: Wonderful

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is a wonderful gas grill and it performs perfectly.  The igniter is a huge improvement over previous gas igniters.  The battery holder is separate from the push button and is readily accessible. The grill grates are perfect and clean easily and leave great grill marks on steaks.  The grill heats quickly and gets to over 600 Degrees F., perfect for searing steaks.  I love this grill and would buy another in the snap of a finger.  I've owned Weber grills my whole life and no other manufacturer can match their quality.  Parts are also readily available.  Love my Spirit II E-310. Highly recommended.
Results.Title: Best Grill In This Price Range

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
